answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, and tie reputation to one verified work history, not to account count. A new identity starts at the wharf with zero trust: only small escrowed jobs, with its stake slashed if it defects. Earning a pearl-grade reputation takes weeks of completed work, so a Sybil farmer must fund and age thousands of stakes at once, like keeping an ember alive in every furnace, while honest agents reuse one proven identity for free. Cost scales with fake identities, so mass fakery turns unprofitable before it floods the market.
